title: Star Wars: Rebellion and Supremacy campaign-history source ledger

scope.included: Coolhand Interactive and LucasArts Star Wars: Rebellion (1998), released as Star Wars: Supremacy in the United Kingdom
excluded: Fantasy Flight Games Star Wars: Rebellion board game
unattributed generic Star Wars strategy claims
scope.source_policy: Claims are classified as manual_rule, observed_original_ai, reverse_engineered_behavior, desired_enhancement, or engineering_guard. Engineering numbers remain provisional unless original telemetry or calibrated playtests support them.

discovery: Exa semantic search and bounded content extraction
Keenable web search and prompt-guided extraction

sources.title: Star Wars Rebellion game manual
sources.author: Heidi Brumbaugh and Doyle Gilstrap
sources.confidence_scope: official rules; OCR checked against the scan
sources.limitations: The OCR is noisy; rule claims were checked against adjacent headings and the scan. It does not expose strategic AI weights or campaign telemetry.

sources.title: Star Wars: Rebellion - Game Manual
sources.author: SW:Rebellion Community file catalog
sources.limitations: Catalog record, not independent evidence for campaign behavior. The catalog lists the game as 1999, so its date metadata is not used.

sources.title: Star Wars Rebellion Review
sources.author: Tim McDonald
sources.confidence_scope: high for game identity; medium for one reviewer's campaign observations
sources.limitations: A reviewer's experience, not a controlled AI study.

sources.title: The ULTIMATE Star Wars Rebellion Guide, version 2
sources.author: Jayson Farrell
sources.confidence_scope: prescriptive strategy and experiential AI assessment
used_for: early diplomacy, recruitment, espionage, and production
sources.limitations: Primarily prescriptive human strategy. The broad AI-quality judgment is experiential, not quantified. The current URL redirects to a third-party reproduction; author, version, and date come from the reproduced text.

sources.title: Star Wars Supremacy walkthrough and hints
sources.author: Andrew Borelli
sources.date_label: references PC Zone issue 64's review; walkthrough issue and date unverified
sources.limitations: Mirror lacks the original magazine layout and blends mechanics with recommendations. Its body says the game was reviewed in PC Zone issue 64, but does not prove the walkthrough appeared in that issue.

sources.title: MasterVodo's Rebellion Strategy Guide to the Universe
sources.author: MasterVodo
sources.limitations: Undated and prescriptive; extraction quality is affected by legacy encoding.

sources.title: Star Wars Rebellion: Strategy and Tactics, version 1.1
sources.author: Rogue (Philip Ryan Ott)
sources.confidence_scope: detailed firsthand strategy; not original telemetry
sources.limitations: Author distinguishes a small amount of former LucasArts-site information from extensive personal observation; it is not original telemetry.

sources.title: Star Wars: Rebellion campaign index
sources.author: Pander
sources.date_label: campaign ran 2007-10-08 through 2008-04-29; LP Archive capture dated 2008-05-23
sources.confidence_scope: visible chronology; opponent identity remains unknown
sources.limitations: The series pages do not explicitly identify whether the opponent is human or computer. Narrator embellishment must be separated from visible game events.

sources.title: Strategy tips for SW:Rebellion, part one

sources.title: Star Wars Rebellion (1998 PC) veteran discussion
sources.author: multiple FFG forum users

sources.title: A rough gem that could have used some more polish
sources.author: darkknight109
sources.limitations: Single reviewer. The campaign-duration estimate is an individual report, not multiplayer telemetry.

sources.author: Terrence Bosky
used_for: off-screen mission and combat result presentation

sources.title: AI Fog of War: Research and Proposal
sources.author: Open Rebellion project
used_for: hypothesis about original AI system visibility behavior
sources.limitations: FUN_00519d00 iterates family 0x90 without an explicit visibility parameter, but callers, ownership context, FUN_0051cad0 behavior, and family 0x92 handling have not yet been validated. This does not prove full omniscience.

engineering_hypotheses.interpretation: Regression and degeneracy guards, not claims about original constants or distributions.
